milestones.title: Oops, Committed
milestones.joke: A secret in git. It happens to everyone.
milestones.when: shell: `git commit` with the lab's fake key staged

milestones.title: Pre-Commit Bouncer
milestones.joke: A hook now stops the next leak.
milestones.when: verify: `.git/hooks/pre-commit` present and blocks the fake key
